blacklistabilityReview.evidence: All four tracked sDAI deployments have reviewed local transfer posture. The prior Ethereum SavingsDai review identifies immutable non-proxy code with ordinary transfer/transferFrom and no holder blacklist, pause, privileged arbitrary-holder burn or upgrade entrypoint. Base and Optimism remain immutable OptimismMintableERC20 representations whose local transfers inherit ordinary ERC20 checks; onlyBridge mint/burn authority is a distinct economic control. The newly covered World Chain sDAI 0x859dbe24b90c9f2f7742083d3cf59ca41f55be5d has exact-match verified OptimismMintableERC20 1.3.0 source on Worldscan. Its immutable REMOTE_TOKEN is canonical Ethereum sDAI and immutable BRIDGE is 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010, both embedded in the runtime. No token-level blacklist, pause, upgrade or holder-transfer permissioning is present; ERC20 transfer hooks are empty. Pinned eth_getCode at World Chain block 35966146 (hash 0xf294a8c1cd77abb22c920b18164a3c9e69cb0de25ceaa775a26785ac9e847924, timestamp 2026-10-06T06:25:31Z), observed 2026-10-09T10:40:50.894Z, returned direct runtime matching the explorer's deployed bytecode. The bridge alone can mint/burn, including an arbitrary from argument at the token interface; this review does not certify all bridge execution paths or current route supply shares. Historical three-deployment supply fractions are not used as current materiality evidence. sDAI retains upstream-only exposure through the DAI dependency and its backing rather than erasing parent exposure.

oracleRisk.summary: sDAI is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over DAI and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required DAI parent carries the separately reviewed Sky Vault oracle, auction, backstop, and bad-debt branch.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sDAI's ERC-4626 conversion functions use the savings accumulator to value DAI assets per share for minting and redemption, making the share exchange rate a price-sensitive top-level authority. The wrapper originates no borrower debt and has no local liquidation markets; its DAI dependency preserves the parent exposure without requiring local branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum sDAI is the native ERC-4626 savings vault. The Base and OP Mainnet contracts are immutable OptimismMintableERC20 representations whose BRIDGE is the chain-local L2StandardBridge and whose REMOTE_TOKEN is Ethereum sDAI, so both routes use the canonical OP Stack lock/mint bridge rather than a Sky PSM or third-party bridge. A near-synchronous 2026-07-21 totalSupply snapshot attributes 144,534.700637683482349953 sDAI, or 0.0984226812% of canonical Ethereum supply, to the two bridge representations.
